rationale: The registered recurrence_scale_v1 design is a semantic DIRECT_MATCH for RQ-REC-002, but the latest 20-seed confirmatory run was provenance-blocked because the source tree was dirty. R2 prospectively repeats the same delay intervention on the current green source freeze with fresh seeds. Historical DATA remain unchanged.
seed_semantics: Fresh seeds are used as deterministic robustness repetitions. They are not assumed to be statistically independent stochastic samples when the registered network construction is seed-insensitive.
freshness_rule: Seeds are disjoint from prior REC-002 seeds 101-120 and from recent Stage-1 clean-run seed ranges.

analysis_plan.inference_policy: No p-values or sampling-based confidence intervals are used. Support is decided by preregistered deterministic within-seed contrasts.
primary_decision_gates: All 80 registered runs are present with the complete four-delay grid for every seed.
Every run completes 256 ticks without runtime error.
For every seed, each treatment delay 2, 4 and 8 differs from delay 1 in at least one primary outcome.
For every seed, at least two treatment-delay signatures are distinct from each other in the vector (last_response_latency, recurrent_events, propagation_depth).
No monotonic direction is required because H-REC-002-A predicts a delay effect, not monotonic improvement.
analysis_plan.support_status: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_PREREGISTERED_PROTOCOL only if every integrity and primary scientific gate passes.
analysis_plan.failure_status: NO_PREDEFINED_SUPPORT_DETECTED if execution is valid but one or more preregistered scientific gates fail.
analysis_plan.integrity_failure_status: NOT_TESTED_INTEGRITY_FAILURE if source freeze, coverage, ticks, provenance or runtime integrity fails.

integrity_constraints: no post-hoc seed or delay replacement
claim_boundary: This experiment can support only the scoped claim that loop delay changes persistence/propagation metrics in the registered small deterministic recurrent SNN at recurrent weight 100 and a 256-tick observation window. It does not establish memory, cognition, biological equivalence, scaling, a 5D advantage, monotonic superiority of larger delays, human-reviewed EVID or independent replication.

gate_protection.source_digest_policy: Do not modify src/, configs/, tests/, research/schemas/ or pyproject.toml in this experiment branch.
gate_protection.merge_policy: Merge only after the experiment verifier and the repository pull-request CI are green.
